# PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS] PLEASE NOTE THIS PD COMES INTO FORCE 1 JANUARY 2026

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS] Contents of this Practice Direction

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS] Title | Number

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS] Scope of this practice direction and interpretation | Para. 1-6

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS] Public Domain Documents | Para. 7-9

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS] Requirement to file Public Domain Documents | Para. 10

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS] Failure to file Public Domain Documents – order to file | Para. 11

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS] Access to Public Domain Documents | Para. 12

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS] Orders restricting access to Public Domain Documents | Para. 13-19

## Scope of this practice direction and interpretation

## Scope

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] 1. This practice direction is made under CPR rule 51.2. It provides for a pilot scheme for arrangements for access to documents in the public domain by parties and non-parties (“the Access to Public Domain Documents Pilot”) to –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] (a) operate  from  1 st January  2026  to  31 st December  2027  (“ the  Pilot Period ”);

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] (b) operate in the following courts (“ the Pilot Courts ”) –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] (i) the Commercial Court and London Circuit Commercial Court of the King’s Bench Division;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] (ii) the Financial List (Commercial Court and Chancery Division);

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] (c) apply to certain documents filed for or used in hearings taking place in public during the Pilot Period in both existing and new proceedings in the Pilot  Courts.  Those  documents,  “Public  Domain  Documents”,  are defined in paragraphs 7 – 8 below.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] 2. The requirement in paragraph 10 to file Public Domain Documents does not apply in proceedings where a party is not legally represented and has not already filed a document in those proceedings using CE-File.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] 3. Unless the court orders otherwise, this practice direction does not affect any other obligation to file a document at court using CE-File, nor any other right or permission to access a court document filed on CE-File. In particular, nothing in this practice direction affects –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] (a) the  operation  of  CPR  rule  5.4B  and  5.4C,  Practice  Direction  5A paragraph 4.2A or Practice Direction 5C;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] (b) the validity of any pre-existing order (for example a confidentiality order under CPR rule 39.2), and any obligation, right or permission in this practice direction is subject to any such pre-existing order;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] (c) any  existing  provisions  in  Practice  Directions  or  Court  Guides  for provision of hard copy skeleton arguments to non-parties.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] 4. In addition to the power in this practice direction to make an FMO in relation to a document that has become or is expected to become a Public Domain Document, the court may make any other order in relation to that document that it would otherwise be able to make, and any obligation, right or permission in this practice direction is subject to any such order.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Scope] 5. This practice direction only applies to documents which become Public Domain Documents in proceedings which are taking place in a Pilot Court.

## Interpretation

## 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] “CE-File” means the electronic filing and case management system used in certain courts containing those documents which the court is required to hold pursuant to the CPR, whether they are documents created by the court or filed by the parties;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] “CE-File website” means the web address at which CE-File can be accessed by parties at https://efile.cefile-app.com/login; (opens in a new tab)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] “CPR” means the Civil Procedure Rules;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] “HMCTS” means His Majesty’s Courts and Tribunals Service;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] “Public Access CE-File” means HMCTS Public Search and Office Copies portal accessible by the public found at https://efile.cefile-app.com/publicsearch/login; (opens in a new tab)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] “the Filing Period” means–

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] (a) in relation to skeleton arguments and written opening and closing submissions two clear days after the start of the hearing or hearing day at which the skeleton argument or written submission is relied upon;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] (b) in relation to documents within paragraph 8 below other than skeleton arguments and written opening and closing submissions the period beginning on the day when the relevant document is used or referred to in a hearing and ending at 16.00 on the fourteenth day after that, unless the court orders otherwise (for example in relation to a multi-day hearing or trial) or the parties agree to earlier filing;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] (c) if the court orders otherwise or the parties agree to an earlier filing, the period beginning on the date of the relevant order or agreement and ending at 16.00 on the final date ordered or agreed for the earlier filing;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] “the Filing Requirement” means the requirement in paragraph 10 to file, within the Filing Period, a document that has become a Public Domain Document;  “Non-party” means a person who is not a party to the case;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 6. In addition to the definitions in paragraph 1, in this practice direction –] “a Filing Modification Order” “FMO” means an order made under paragraph13 in relation to a document that has or, under paragraph 7 and 8 would be  expected to become, a Public Domain Document.

## Public Domain Documents

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Public Domain Documents] 7. Unless the court orders otherwise under paragraph 13, for the purposes of this Pilot documents referred to in paragraph 8 which have been used or referred to at a hearing in public are Public Domain Documents from the start of the Filing Period.

## 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (a) skeleton arguments;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (b) written opening submissions;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (c) written closing submissions;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (d) other written submissions provided to a judge and relied upon in the hearing;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (e) witness statements and affidavits –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (i) including those relied upon as evidence in chief at trial and those relied upon at a public hearing of an application;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (ii) not including documents appended or annexed to the witness statement or affidavit;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (f)  expert reports, including –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (i) those adduced as evidence in chief at trial and those relied upon at a public hearing of an application;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (ii) annexes and appendices to expert reports;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (g) any other document or documents critical to the understanding of the hearing ordered by the judge at the hearing to be a Public Domain Document;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] (h) any  documents  agreed  by  the  parties  to  be  Public  Domain Documents.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 8. The documents referred to in this paragraph are –] 9. If a Public Domain Document refers to another document, that other document does not become a Public Domain Document unless it is a document referred to in paragraph 8.

## Requirement to file Public Domain Documents

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Requirement to file Public Domain Documents] 10. Irrespective  of  whether  the  document  has  already  been  filed  on  CE-File website, the party which has produced any document which becomes a Public Domain Document under paragraphs 7 and 8 must, subject to paragraphs 13 to  19,  file  that  document  on  CE-File  website  under  the  relevant  CE-File designations listed in Table A within the Filing Period.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Requirement to file Public Domain Documents] Table A

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Requirement to file Public Domain Documents] Document type | CE-File designations

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Requirement to file Public Domain Documents] Skeleton Argument | Public Skeleton Argument

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Requirement to file Public Domain Documents] Written Submissions | Public Written Submissions

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Requirement to file Public Domain Documents] Witness Statements | Public Witness Statement

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Requirement to file Public Domain Documents] Affidavits | Public Witness Statement

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Requirement to file Public Domain Documents] Expert Report | Public Expert Report

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Requirement to file Public Domain Documents] Other documents | Public Document Other

## Failure to file Public Domain Documents– order to file

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Failure to file Public Domain Documents– order to file] 11. If a party does not comply with the Filing Requirement, the court may order that party to file the document that has not been filed.

## Access to Public Domain Documents

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Access to Public Domain Documents] 12. Subject to any order which may be made under paragraph 13, any person, including a Non-party, may obtain copies from Public Access CE-File of any Public Domain Document which has been filed pursuant to the provisions of this Pilot Scheme.

## Orders restricting access to Public Domain Documents

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Orders restricting access to Public Domain Documents] 13 . The court may make an order in relation to a document that has become, or, under paragraphs 7 and 8 would be expected to become, a Public Domain Document (an “FMO”) –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Orders restricting access to Public Domain Documents] (a) that  a  non-party  may  not  obtain  a  copy  of  that  document  under paragraph 12;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Orders restricting access to Public Domain Documents] (b) waiving or restricting the Filing Requirement;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Orders restricting access to Public Domain Documents] (c) that  the  Filing  Requirement  need  be  complied  with  only  after  that document has been edited or redacted in accordance with the directions of the court;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Orders restricting access to Public Domain Documents] (d) extending or otherwise amending the Filing Period;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > Orders restricting access to Public Domain Documents] (e) making such other order in respect of that document as it thinks fit.

## 14. The court may make an FMO of its own initiative or it may be sought by –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 14. The court may make an FMO of its own initiative or it may be sought by –] (a) any party; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 14. The court may make an FMO of its own initiative or it may be sought by –] (b) any Non-party named or referred to in a Public Domain Document, or a document that under paragraphs 7 and 8 would be expected to become a Public Domain Document in relation to the document in which they are named or referred.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 14. The court may make an FMO of its own initiative or it may be sought by –] 15. Where a party seeks an FMO in relation to a document that is expected to become a Public Domain Document under paragraphs 7 and 8, as soon as practicable and before the commencement of the expected Filing Period they must file on CE-File website and, where applicable, with the clerk to the judge who presided over the hearing, a written request and a proposed FMO on notice to the other parties containing reasons (and where necessary, evidence) in support of the proposed FMO.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 14. The court may make an FMO of its own initiative or it may be sought by –] 16. Where a Non-party named in a document that is expected to become a Public Domain Document under paragraphs 7 and 8 seeks an FMO, they must file an application notice under Part 23 on notice to the parties as soon as practicable and before the commencement of the expected Filing Period for that document.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 14. The court may make an FMO of its own initiative or it may be sought by –] 17. Where such a request is made under paragraph 15 or an application is made under paragraph 16 the relevant Filing Period will not commence until the request or application has been determined and the document the subject of the request or application must not be filed until it has been determined and subject to that determination.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 14. The court may make an FMO of its own initiative or it may be sought by –] 18. Where any party or a Non-party named or referred to in a document seeks an FMO in relation to a document that has already become a Public Domain Document they must apply under Part 23 on notice to the other parties and any person named in that document who has previously applied for an FMO.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 14. The court may make an FMO of its own initiative or it may be sought by –] 19. Where the court makes an FMO, a Non-party may apply for a copy of any  document or an unedited copy of any document to which the order applies by  making an application under Part 23 on notice to all parties and to any person named in that document who obtained the FMO in relation to that document.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZH – ACCESS TO PUBLIC DOMAIN DOCUMENTS > 14. The court may make an FMO of its own initiative or it may be sought by –] Updated: Monday, 20 October 2025
